annotations_text.name: annotations_text
annotations_text.value: char_length("annotations"."text") between 1 and 4000 and ("annotations"."kind" = 'note' or char_length("annotations"."text") <= 1000)

entries_rating.name: entries_rating
entries_rating.value: "entries"."rating" is null or ("entries"."rating" between 0.5 and 5 and "entries"."rating" * 2 = floor("entries"."rating" * 2))

reading_progress_total.name: reading_progress_total
reading_progress_total.value: "reading_progress"."total_pages" is null or ("reading_progress"."total_pages" between 1 and 100000 and "reading_progress"."page" <= "reading_progress"."total_pages")
